name: Free off-peak Canberra buses and light rail for Health Care Card holders
summary: Health Care Card holders ride Canberra buses and light rail free off-peak and on weekends, and pay concession fares at other times.
key: Health Care Card holders travel for free on weekdays from 9:00 am to 4:30 pm and after 6:00 pm, and all day on weekends and public holidays.
who: Primary holder of an Australian Government Health Care Card or Pension Card
how: Register your concession in your MyWay+ account: Register concession, choose Concession under Fare Type, select your concession type and submit.
catches: Most MyWay+ concessions automatically expired on 30 June 2026, so check yours is still active.
Concession fares apply to the primary card holder at all times.

evidence.quote: The following card holders travel for free on weekdays from 9:00 am to 4:30 pm and after 6:00 pm (off-peak).
